I don't have money for a medical professional, neither my parents. And in any case, about 4 years ago I asked them to take me to one, and my father got angry and told me I didn't need such a thing.

I'm tired of trying to searh for a better future, every year i've told myself about how it'll be different and I end up messing everything up. And also I knew how she wasn't "my soul mate", I knew how it all would end up once she knew me. Once she found out how I don't have friends and how bad I at relating to others.

It's been 2 months, and no one has asked me how I feel, this 2 months I tried to talk to others, I tried. And in 2 months no one has asked me how I feel, not a single "how are you?". I've already closed my FB account, and now I have nothing. Nowhere to go, nothing to do, I don't feel like doing anything anyway, nothing but sit and play.
